artist.name: Victoria Nadine
artist.short_description: Victoria Nadine — an Afterglow editorial selection for listeners exploring Norwegian pop.
artist.biography: Victoria Nadine is the professional name of Norwegian pop singer Victoria Karlskås Andersen, from Skien. A Universal Music Norway release biography records her participation in Idol as a teenager and identifies her 2020 single ‘Be Okay’ as a breakthrough. Her later Norwegian chart history includes ‘Nerve’, ‘hope ur miserable’, ‘Summer Rain’ and ‘Saw It Coming’. She has also worked with other performers on records such as ‘Feel This Way’ and ‘Favorite Mistakes’. In 2025, her music reached a wider international audience through ‘Can't Get Enough’, a collaboration with Kygo, alongside singles including ‘Real To Me’ and ‘Cherry’. The official label account of her career is useful evidence for milestones; however, it does not automatically establish an emotional or biographical explanation for each song. Within Afterglow, Nadine can connect listeners who enjoy Astrid S and Clara Mae to a somewhat more upbeat Scandinavian pop sound with relationship-oriented material. That last comparison is editorial rather than an endorsed association between the artists.

career_milestones.description: Released Nerve, later appearing on Norwegian charts.
Released Can’t Get Enough with Kygo and Cherry.
